crossRefs.note: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned…

parallels.note: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned…

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

translations.web: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.
translations.bsb: So in the forty-first year of his reign, Asa died and rested with his fathers.
translations.kjv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
translations.asv: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
